d: Spain heads into a crucial snap general election, with the right-wing opposition seeking to end eight years of Socialist-led rule under Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. The conservative People's Party (PP), led by Alberto Núñez Feijóo, is looking to form a government, potentially with the support of far-right Vox. With housing, immigration and corruption among the key campaign issues, the election could reshape Spain's political landscape and have wider implications for Europe. WION's Race to Power examines the contest and what is at stake.
